resource_review.V1_calls: K all-row calls + B selected chunk calls (0..K) + C nonempty whole-job D0 calls (0..32); B selected row volume <=32*Nmax.
resource_review.V2_calls: Same K all-row calls + Q1 nonempty whole-job D0 calls (0..32) + Q3 nonempty whole-job D2 calls (0..32); default Q2=0.
resource_review.call_delta: At most+32 whole-job selected calls if old B had0 calls; usually removal of many B calls, but no runtime speedup guarantee. Replacing B row-volume upper bound with Q3 preserves 32*Nmax bound; BLAS timing is not derived from row counts.
resource_review.chunk_bound_derivation: At most154 admitted nonempty segments per job; sum ceil(n_s/512) <= ceil(N/512)+153. Global source segment upper bound inherited from public E input contract.
resource_review.comparison_vector_derivation: Selected delta, selected cache, and both tobytes copies, each <=8*Nmax; do not retain selected arrays across jobs.
resource_review.disclosure: Actual gate-dependent call/row counts and resource telemetry remain private under joint suppression.
resource_review.input_budget: No additional source reads: Q1/Q3 consume resident same-order TRAIN features/model/cache. Same3000 opens/64GiB cap. No private diagnostic opens by default.
resource_review.qualification_matrix_derivation: Eight Nmax*Pmax*8 buffers reserved: x_full, selected x, transform output, advanced-index copy, subtraction temp, division temp, up to two assembly/transient work buffers. Verify exact caller peak liveness before execution; no hidden concatenation/BLAS workspace beyond allowance.
resource_review.receipt_derivation: At most4096 canonical bytes per job per Q1/Q3 proof, no transformed/prediction/row arrays; <=256KiB per repeat included in unchanged32MiB result and384MiB total caps.
resource_review.time_budget: CPU21600s/wall43200s per repeat are unchanged hard ABORT caps, NOT proof that V2 will finish. Qualify approved runner capacity/environment and frozen caller liveness before future private numeric reads; insufficient evidence=>E2_RESOURCE_PREFLIGHT_BLOCKED; never auto-extend.

resources.derivation: V1 original buffer bound1410679894 + conservative extra8*N336941*P93*8 matrix workspace +32*N comparison bytes +262144 qualification proof bytes +2GiB runtime reserve; intentional double-count of V1 design work for safety. This bound is below unchanged8GiB address-space cap but is conditional on future exact-caller liveness/BLAS workspace proof. CPU6h/wall12h/input3000opens64GiB/output384MiB/reserve2GiB remain hard caps; no private capacity measurement or completion guarantee.

algorithm.resource_gate: E2 freezes actual N/dtype/chunk/feature sizes, all buffer formulas and hard RAM/CPU/wall/disk/reserve caps against verified capacity BEFORE NUMERIC READ; inability=>E2_INPUT_INSUFFICIENT
steps: Validate full job/provenance/model/labels/counts/context support and all-row potential outcomes before any selection.
Reconstruct combined D0 once from saved TRAIN p/y; numerical-qualify common potentials; build each context D0 reference with canonical tree.
Stable sort scalar (score,original_row_position); canonicalize numeric zero and group exact-equal scores. Only index views sort; original arrays are never reordered.

Initialize all MOVE leaves and exact counters; for ascending distinct candidates in {0,1}+scores replace every p<=candidate newly crossing row by HOLD leaf; remove full equal-score group before evaluation.
Update exact integer gain/TP/harm counts and recompute affected tree ancestors from children. Test four guards and lexicographic key; retain only best state and private decision.
No per-candidate row materialization, numeric-score grid refinement, weight tuning, margins, mixing or automatic retries. Seal all decisions before DEV.
algorithm.tree_memory_bound: 4 channels * 2*M * 8 bytes = 64*M bytes < 128*N bytes for N>1; N=1 uses64bytes; plus O(N) frozen input/potential/index buffers.

leaf_arithmetic: truth_delta = int(t_i)-int(c_i), then exact float64 conversion
e = float64((u_i if MOVE else +0.0) - float64(truth_delta))
sq = float64(e*e); ab = abs(e); no fused operations
true_move leaf uses same sq/ab if t_i != c_i else +0.0
numerics.tree_layout: For context N, compact immutable original row order; M=next_power_of_two(N); leaves 0..N-1 original-order values and N..M-1 +0.0; each parent fl64(left+right), fixed topology.
